offer.serviceDescription: Done-for-you cold email outreach that books qualified sales calls with F&B shippers, we build the list, write the copy, run warmed sending domains, and put booked calls on your calendar.
offer.uniqueAngle: Be the no-risk backup broker on a painful lane, second-source reefer capacity with continuous temperature monitoring and full carrier vetting on every load.
guarantees: No pay for no-shows or unqualified calls
Warmed lookalike domains, your Aries domain is never at deliverability risk
problemsSolved: OTIF retail chargebacks ($100-$500+ per shipment) the logistics director is personally graded on
Perishable, must-arrive-by delivery windows that are tight and non-negotiable
Temperature-claim disputes when the data trail is incomplete
Reefer-LTL underservice and 2026 reefer capacity tightness, reliable backup coverage
offer.quantifiableResults: Adjacent proof only: 7 booked calls in 10 days on a prior pilot (different industry), not freight. No F&B freight results to claim yet; the pilot targets 3 booked calls. Do not reference freight case studies that don't exist.
process: We tune this ICP with you
We build and verify the lead list
We run warmed-domain outreach and book the calls
You take the meetings; we optimize weekly

items.q: How should we handle pricing / rate requests?
items.a: Don't quote rates in email, offer a quick lane review or a short call to scope it.

items.q: What if they ask 'are you just a broker reselling my freight?'
items.a: Lead with carrier vetting + temperature monitoring on every load; position as vetted backup capacity, not a reseller.

items.q: Can we reference named clients (e.g. Anheuser-Busch)?
items.a: Confirm with Kevin before any name-drop in outbound copy.
